# target_ct bytes from 0x402060 (25 bytes)
target_ct = bytes([0x07, 0xcb, 0x92, 0x53, 0x20, 0xe7, 0x69, 0x03, 0xd8, 0x6c, 
                   0xe4, 0x37, 0x53, 0xc4, 0x96, 0x56, 0xf1, 0xcc, 0x4d, 0xce, 
                   0x97, 0x63, 0xff, 0xcc, 0x4f])

# Reverse the algorithm:
# target_ct[i] = input[i] ^ edx
# So: input[i] = target_ct[i] ^ edx
# And edx starts at 0x41, after each iteration: edx = (edx + input[i]) & 0xFF

edx = 0x41
result = []

for i in range(25):
    input_char = target_ct[i] ^ edx
    result.append(chr(input_char))
    edx = (edx + input_char) & 0xFF

answer = ''.join(result)
print(f"Decoded input: {answer}")
print(f"Length: {len(answer)}")

# Verify the answer
edx_verify = 0x41
for i, ch in enumerate(answer):
    xored = ord(ch) ^ edx_verify
    print(f"i={i}: char={ch!r} ord={ord(ch)} edx={hex(edx_verify)} xored={hex(xored)} target={hex(target_ct[i])} match={xored==target_ct[i]}")
    edx_verify = (edx_verify + ord(ch)) & 0xFF
